notes.title: Balance patch 0.7.10
notes.content: [p][b]Game has been updated to version 0.7.10.[/b][/p][p][b]Changelog:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Damage of the MP-133 reduced by 5.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to choose a starting bonus (armor, backpack, or weapon) on Easy and Medium difficulties (only when playing solo).[/p][/*][*][p]Bot gear upgrade speed and difficulty increase are now tied to player progression (previously depended on match time).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where character actions would trigger while typing in chat.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved lighting from muzzle flashes and explosions.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted bot respawns to avoid large clusters.[/p][/*][*][p]Equipment upgrades now have a cooldown (previously could be reused only after death).[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the explosion radius of propane.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an awkward ledge in the center of the Outskirts map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed one of the errors that could cause a crash at the end of a match.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where previously searched containers didn’t give experience for searching after loot was updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Bots now notice the player more slowly if they are outside their line of sight.[/p][/*][*][p]Bots can now miss with a small chance, which depends on difficulty.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Early Access Launch
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!
The day has finally come — my game is now in Early Access. This is a solo project I’ve been working on for a long time, and today I’m excited to share it with you.[/p][p][/p][p]This version already includes the core gameplay mechanics, the feel, and the atmosphere I wanted to convey. It’s still not the [i]complete[/i] experience, but you can already get a taste of what the final game will be like. Early Access allows me to continue improving the game with your feedback while adding new content, balancing, and polishing along the way.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Changelog since the last public demo:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The game has been fully migrated from Godot 3.5 to Godot 4.3.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam authentication added (allows starting the game without internal registration).[/p][/*][*][p]61 achievements added.[/p][/*][*][p]New character screen — allows unlocking clothing, masks, and bandages, and viewing overall game statistics.[/p][/*][*][p]New clothing, masks, and multiple bandages in different colors added.[/p][/*][*][p]In-game voice chat (enables talking to both allies and enemies, with distance-based voice).[/p][/*][*][p]Loot containers across the map with respawn timers.[/p][/*][*][p]26 loot items of varying rarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Transition to P2P multiplayer — players can now create and configure servers themselves.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated lighting — dynamic sunlight and improved surface light effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Overhauled character system — more responsive controls, various bugs from the previous engine version fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]All character animations and transitions reworked.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated ragdoll system for corpses.[/p][/*][*][p]Match upgrade screen — allows selling found loot and purchasing equipment.[/p][/*][*][p]All game modes updated — players now start with minimal gear; to upgrade, they must level up and earn money to buy equipment. The old gear menu system has been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]PvE mode updated — AI enemies now spawn in random locations across the map continuously during the match.[/p][/*][*][p]PvP mode updated — AI enemies now appear, their number depending on the number of players (more players → fewer bots).[/p][/*][*][p]Bots rebalanced across all difficulty levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Most game effects overhauled (shooting, explosions, hits, etc.).[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon balance updated in accordance with the new upgrade system.[/p][/*][*][p]Inventory UX improvements (quick move using RMB or Ctrl + LMB on PC).[/p][/*][*][p]Camera improvements — now movable in the direction the player is looking; abrupt camera movements fixed, recoil effect improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Propane barrels can now be blown up.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who has waited and supported this project. For me, this is more than just a game — it’s a journey from idea to release. I hope you enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed creating it. Share your impressions — your feedback helps move the game forward.[/p]

notes.title: Early Access Release Slightly Delayed
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,

Quick update — the Early Access release is going to be a bit later than planned. The build is ready, but I’m waiting for Steam’s review process to finish, and unfortunately that’s out of my hands.

I’m aiming for next week, but since the timing depends on Steam, I can’t give a hard date just yet. As soon as the game is approved, I’ll hit the release button right away.

Thanks for your patience — we’re almost there![/p]

notes.title: Early Access Release Date
notes.content:
[p]Heу everyone!
[/p][p]I am happy to announce that the Early Access launch is planned for August 22, 2025.[/p][p]At the moment, I have finished porting the game to the new engine (Godot 4.3), during which the following was done:[/p][list][*][p]New PvE and PvP game modes[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to create a lobby and adjust the difficulty level[/p][/*][*][p]Added looting mechanics (containers with loot all over the map and loot items, with the ability to sell them)[/p][/*][*][p]Completely reworked character animations[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked and improved game effects (flying shells, gunpowder gases, explosions, impact effects, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated dynamic lighting (sunlight, more realistic surface lighting)[/p][/*][*][p]Completely new netcode (P2P using Steam Networking Sockets), this has improved the situation with desyncs/lags during the match[/p][/*][*][p]Updated character action system and added multiple QoL improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Added 60 Steam achievements and fully integrated the Steam ecosystem into the game[/p][/*][*][p]And more[/p][/*][/list][p]As a result of this transition, I was also able to rework many parts of the code, so it will be much easier to make changes to the game. More details on the changes will be described after the Early Access release.[/p][p][/p][p]Early Access Goals:[/p][list][*][p]Add content to the game (maps, modes, equipment, factions, quests)[/p][/*][*][p]Fix various bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Improve game balance[/p][/*][/list][p]It will be much easier and more effective to do this with real feedback from players. So I hope for your help to make the game better :)[/p][p][/p][p]Gameplay Teaser: [dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/RDIful7WFu4"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Why late 2024 release is not possible?
notes.content:
Hello, friends. I created this post to notify those who care about the fate of this game that the release is postponed indefinitely.
To understand the reasons for this decision, let's look at the history of this game. I started active development around 2019, then spent about four years creating what some of you might have seen in the demo version. All this time, I essentially financed myself so that I could study tools, practices, and concepts at a comfortable pace for myself. But now I do not have this opportunity and I needed to shift my focus to work (IT). Although I continued to work on Lost Lives, I did not have time to bring it to a high-quality look by the end of 2024.
Although I could have made a release "for the sake of it", I chose to finish the game with a shift in the release date. Now the game is in the process of switching to a new version of the Godot engine, which has significantly improved character animations, lighting, reworked part of the game code, and improved the multiplayer. I really hope that soon I will be able to return to full-fledged development of the project with new knowledge, experience and strength!

P.S. Forgive me, please, who was waiting for this release.
